module: Mechanical supercharger subsystem attached to an engine: the supercharger is driven by the crankshaft (ratio gearRatio, with a progressive clutch between clutchEngageRPM and clutchDisengageRPM). Three types: 'roots', 'screws', 'centrifugal', each with its own efficiency curve and pulsation level. Computes the boost pressure (psi/1000 RPM, boostController curve according to throttle opening, blow-off valve), applies it to engine.forcedInductionCoef and takes a torque loss proportional to engine speed (crankLossPer1kRPM). Also generates the supercharger whine.
notes: jbeam units: pressures in psi, speeds in RPM (conversion rpmToAV 0.10471971768, avToRPM 9.5493). electrics values written: superchargerBoost (psi), superchargerBoostMax (= maximum pressure of the curve, in psi).

jbeam keys: type ('roots', 'screws' or 'centrifugal', required; unknown type -> error log and init aborted), gearRatio (1), maxRPM (max supercharger speed; default ceil(engine maxRPM*gearRatio)), pressurePSIPer1kRPM (required, pressure slope), boostController (list of [throttle in %, coefficient], required: index 0..100 of the curve = throttle opening *100), lobes (2..4, default 3; screws forces at least 3; centrifugal forces 0), twistedLobes (roots), pulseCoefModifier, crankLossPer1kRPM (5 -> 0.005 loss per 1000 RPM), clutchEngageRPM (1000), clutchEngageRange, clutchDisengageRPM (2*engine maxRPM), clutchDisengageRange, pressureRatePSI (50 psi/s), sounds: whineLoopEvent, whinePitchPer10kRPM (0.65), whineVolumePerPSI (0.01), whineVolumePer10kRPM.
Pulsations: pulseCoefModifier defaults to 0.98 for screws, 0.95 (twisted roots) or 0.9 (straight roots), 1 for centrifugal; frequency = number of lobes * supercharger speed.

The curve pressure is computed as pressureCoef(relative rpm) * slope * rpm with a type-specific order-2 polynomial; the blow-off valve cuts the pressure beyond bypassConditions.maxPressure (very high by default, adjustable with setBypassPressure) and to 0 if the throttle is below 1%.
Torque gain: forcedInductionCoef *= max(1 + 0.0000087*pressure_Pa - loss, 0), called in updateFixedStep at each physics step.

Bug/inconsistency: setPartCondition builds integrityState with damageFrictionCoef and damageExhaustPowerCoef (copied from the turbo) then reads integrityState.damagePressureCoef: when integrity is a number, damagePressureCoef always comes back as 1 (the integrity is ignored).
Bug/inconsistency: getPartCondition calls min(pressureIntegrityValue) with a single argument (equivalent to the value itself).

Bug/inconsistency: maxPressure is a module-local variable never reset to 0 in init (accumulates the maximum across module reloads). applyDeformGroupDamage reports 'inductionSystemDamaged' but reset does not clear it (only 'superchargerDamaged' is cleared).

Bug/inconsistency: the 'forcedInductionInfo' stream reads electrics.values.boost and electrics.values.boostMax, which this file does not write (it writes superchargerBoost / superchargerBoostMax); without an engine that defines boost/boostMax, arithmetic on nil is possible.
After an early return from init (unknown type, missing boostController), updateGFX and updateFixedStep remain nop and the internal variables (pressureCurve...) are partially initialized.

isExisting.desc: Always true: tells the engine that a supercharger exists.

updateFixedStep.desc: nop by default; becomes the physics update after a successful init. ⚠ nop is a game global.

updateGFX.desc: nop by default; becomes the graphics update after a successful init.

init.desc: Initializes the supercharger for an engine: reads the jbeam, generates the pressure curve and the boostController curve, computes the maximum supercharger speed and installs updateGFX/updateFixedStep. If jbeamData is nil, disables updateGFX.

reset.desc: Resets the pressure smoother and the damage and wear coefficients, and clears 'superchargerDamaged'.

updateGFX.desc: Graphics frame: progressive clutch state, supercharger speed and RPM, pulsations, pressure with blow-off valve and smoothing, torque loss, electrics.superchargerBoost and 'forcedInductionInfo' stream.

updateFixedStep.desc: Physics step: multiplies assignedEngine.forcedInductionCoef by the supercharger torque gain (pressure) minus the crankshaft loss.

initSounds.desc: Creates the supercharger whine sound (soundObj) on the engine node and computes the volume and pitch coefficients.

updateSounds.desc: Sets the whine volume and pitch according to the supercharger pressure and speed.

setBypassPressure.desc: Sets the pressure above which the blow-off valve limits the supercharger pressure.

getTorqueCoefs.desc: Estimates the supercharger torque gain coefficient for each RPM of the engine torque curve (clutch and ratio taken into account).

returns.desc: Table keyed by rpm+1: coefficient (1 = no gain).

applyDeformGroupDamage.desc: Reduces the delivered pressure (damagePressureCoef, down to -0.1) when a deform group is damaged, and reports 'inductionSystemDamaged'.

setPartCondition.desc: Applies wear (odometer: pressure down to 50% at 1e9) and integrity of a part loaded from a save. See the bug noted on damagePressureCoef.
